info.title: CareerLens API
info.description: CareerLens API supports guest resume uploads, public DB posting selection and real analysis. Guest content stays in a server-side temporary workspace for a fixed 30 minutes; only an allowlisted metadata/question/completion response is exposed. Login or signup is required to atomically claim a completed report into the account workspace. Original upload binaries are never persisted. Existing authenticated endpoints and the 70/20/10 evidence rubric are unchanged. CSRF and origin checks protect all mutations.

get.summary: Validate the provider callback and establish the local session
get.description: Provider-facing browser callback. Requires the cookie that initiated OAuth. Authlib validates OAuth state and, for OIDC, the signed ID token and nonce. Failure or cancellation also redirects to the frontend with an auth_error query parameter; no provider token is returned to the browser.

get.summary: Browse public examples plus own private manual postings
get.description: Anonymous reads show examples only. Logged-in reads include own manual posts and bookmark status. saved=1 requires authentication. Facets include all visible postings independent of active filters. Literal case-insensitive q searches company, role, description and skills; other filters are exact, skill is case-insensitive. No external API calls.

post.description: Requires uploaded resume and a selected public DB posting. Uses the existing analysis engine and optional question answers. Report and scores stay on the server. Limit 6 attempts per guest session and 60 per socket peer per 30 minutes. Deleted, expired or claimed drafts cannot be recreated by late analysis writes.

post.summary: Claim the current session completed guest analysis into the authenticated account workspace
post.description: Login/register/OAuth preserve the opaque guest pointer while rotating auth and CSRF. Requires the newly issued CSRF token. Atomic single-use transfer replaces the account current workspace with the completed guest draft and deletes temporary data. Missing/incomplete/expired guest data never modifies the account workspace. No client-supplied guest/user ID is accepted.

404.description: No guest pointer in this session; code guest_missing

409.description: Guest analysis not complete; code guest_incomplete

410.description: Guest draft expired, discarded or already claimed; code guest_expired

sessionCookie.name: careerlens_session
sessionCookie.description: Signed HttpOnly cookie containing opaque pointers to server-side auth and guest state. Guest endpoints accept an anonymous session; claim and existing member workflow endpoints require a valid authenticated server session.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Token returned by GET /auth/session, bound to the same cookie. Replace after login, registration, logout and password reset.

improvement_preview.description: Unavailable when the rubric is unsupported, the report is incomplete, or no supported improvements remain.

selected_posting_id.description: Selected DB posting ID. company, role and job_text retain the analyzed snapshot.

answers.description: Only IDs returned by the current questions endpoint are accepted; omitted answers are empty.

csrf_token.description: Send in X-CSRF-Token on unsafe API requests. Replaced after registration, login, logout and password reset.

mail_mode.description: local writes password reset mail to the private server outbox; smtp uses configured SMTP.

token.description: Single-use reset token from the reset email; expires after 15 minutes.

PasswordResetResult.description: Anonymous session (user is null), rotated csrf_token, and completion message. Other sessions for this user are revoked.

source_url.description: Optional http(s) URL without credentials. Stored only; never fetched by this API.

JobPosting.description: Examples are fictional educational postings. Manual postings are visible only to their creator. source_url on examples identifies role inspiration, not a live opening at the fictional company.

AgentMetadata.description: Execution events, not model chain-of-thought. Default workflow is deterministic.

CatalogMatching.description: Current saved resume and optional evidence compared with all visible catalog jobs. Local rules total: job evidence70 + performed context20 + quantified outcomes10. Not hiring probability. Private postings belong only to this session user.

role.description: Required non-empty when role_id=custom; ignored for predefined roles.

focus.description: Optional user context used to tailor one follow-up question; never an invented employer requirement or direct score modifier.

Preparation.description: Actual server-completed work, bound to resume/target/reference fingerprint. Errors never mark the stage complete. No elapsed-time percentage is claimed.

fingerprint.description: Send current workspace preparation fingerprint to reject stale input.

ImprovementPreview.description: Hypothetical rules-only result if every listed evidence assumption becomes true. Not an assessed report, actual resume edit, or promised score.

selected_posting_id.description: Selected DB posting ID. company, role and job_text retain the analyzed snapshot.

GuestWorkspace.description: Strict guest allowlist. Never contains resume_text, job_text, answers, report, scores or preparation. completed and report_locked become true only after the actual report has been generated and persisted server-side. Empty or expired workspace returns false flags and null expires_at. expired distinguishes an expired/missing existing guest from a visitor with no guest data.

expires_at.description: Fixed UTC expiry: first valid upload plus 30 minutes. Edits and analyses never extend it.

expired.description: True only when this session has a stale guest pointer whose row has expired or disappeared. Allows a fresh OAuth return page to explain expiration rather than showing an older account report. Never true for a new visitor or after explicit discard.

tags.name: Guest workspace
tags.description: 30-minute server-side temporary analysis with authenticated report claim. Expired rows are deleted independently every 30 seconds while the server is running and on startup/access.
